text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaahーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft—!
A terrifying new heroine is born!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez, not again...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My rival—
she just keeps going, on and on without end!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The "New Heroine," huh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaahhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Craaaft!
That was amaaaazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mile Queen!!
We're rooting for you from here on out, too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Just for today, it's my complete defeat.
Well done, Craft...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on 1st place!
You truly walked the walkâwhat a wonderful race!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
There were so many firsts, and I felt a bit anxious myself...
But I was able to run with a calm mind!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I feel like... I was able to run the race I wanted to...
And that I was truly able to show my brilliance...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sight of Cesario's close friend quickly became a hot topic, especially among the Tiara horse girls!

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft, that was amazing!
Switching your focus to the mile was totally the right call~.

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Going from the Oka Sho to the NHK Mile Cup... I actually think that's a pretty solid route!

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Right... What should I do? Maybe I should
try talking to my Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(............
The path where you "shine the brightest"... huh.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Yes... It was magnificent. So much so that my heart is still trembling.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...No, let's stop overthinking.
First and foremost, the Oaks!
I must devote all my focus to that.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, congratulations, Kraft.
May happiness follow wherever your path leads."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the NHK Mile Cup
came to a close.
